responsibility: Implements the shared LoongArch target option resolver used by both the compiler proper and the driver. It combines defaults, explicit -m switches, -march/-mtune/-mfpu/-mabi/-mcmodel settings, native CPU detection, ABI-to-ISA compatibility rules, multilib availability, fallback and diagnostic paths, and unsupported code-model handling to produce the final struct loongarch_target configuration and to report resolved option status back to GCC’s help machinery.
same_name_distinction: Contains the shared option-resolution engine for the loongarch-opts pair: it computes the final loongarch_target from requested -m settings, defaults, native CPU data, ABI compatibility, and multilib constraints. Unlike loongarch-opts.h, it performs the resolution and diagnostics rather than exposing the API and condition macros.
